note: The index board. Every row that is not in force carries the reason it is not — `disabled`, `overridden` naming the winner, `other_owner`, `unresolved`. The rows here were saved and deleted by the dump; the board is the fixture.

profiles.name: Sightings-heavy (experiment)
profiles.description:
Forked from “default-v1” on 2026-09-07.

The instance default Analyst Profile. Phase 2 authored the eleven-signal catalogue and its weights against the regression set: the four demo values anchor the shape, the median value (one org, no sightings) fixes the calibration rule. Phase 5 completed the relevance section: the clock, the curve at decay_speed 1, and the per-type TTL table, which errs generous because a short TTL drops indicators silently and a long one merely fails to flag a stale one. Phase 6 added reference.org_trust_scale, the admiralty grade multipliers, with both override maps still empty: an empty org_trust map switches trust weighting off entirely, so this profile scores exactly as it did before the section existed. See prd/analyst-profile/03-signals.md section 7, 06-staleness.md section 3 and 07-reference.md section 2.3.

fork_confirm.note: What `fork()` returns before it forks anything, when the reader already holds an enabled profile (09-editor.md section 6). Two shapes: forking to yourself, and forking to the organisation, which names how many colleagues it would change.

provenance.users_and_own_profile: Counted on the dev instance 2026-09-11 the way `AnalystProfilesController::__orgReaders()` counts them: active users in the org, minus those holding an enabled profile of their own. ADMIN has 4 active users and, before this dump ran, none with their own enabled profile.
provenance.own_profile_here: This board's reader does hold one — it is the `in_force` row above — so 1 of the 4 is exempt and 3 are affected.

to_me.message: You already have an enabled profile, Sightings-heavy (experiment). Replacing it disables it — it is not deleted — and the fork becomes the one in force.

to_org.message: An organisation profile is what every colleague who has not forked resolves to. This one would change how values are scored for 3 users.

after.note: A fork has no lineage: a new uuid, counters reset, no parent_uuid. Its description is rewritten, because a verbatim copy made a fork claim to be the default (09-editor.md:435-443).
